metadata.topic: Thermal Physics — Gradient of Temperature-Time Graph (SHC Experiment)
metadata.note: Data: θ/°C = {25.3, 30.5, 34.9, 41.2, 46.4, 51.5, 56.8} at t/s = {0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300, 360}. Heater P=105W, m=300g liquid. Using extreme points: G = (56.8−25.3)/(360−0) = 31.5/360 = 0.0875 °C/s. Wide tolerances accommodate own-figure from student-plotted best-fit line. Follows Q1c (plotting — not auto-gradeable).

question.name: CSEC Phy Jun 2023 Q1d — Gradient of θ vs t Graph
question.text:
An experiment is conducted to determine the specific heat capacity of 300 g of a liquid using a heater with power rating 105 W. Temperature data from the experiment is shown in Table 1 below:

Temperature θ / °CTime t / s
25.30
30.560
34.9120
41.2180
46.4240
51.5300
56.8360

Calculate the gradient G of the temperature-time graph using two well-separated points on your best-fit line. (5 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Model gradient (using extreme data points):
Δθ = 56.8 − 25.3 = 31.5 °C
Δt = 360 − 0 = 360 s
G = Δθ / Δt = 31.5 / 360 = 0.0875 °C s⁻¹

Own-figure marking: Full marks if gradient is correctly calculated from two clearly identified, well-separated points on the best-fit line. Accepted range: 0.080–0.095 °C/s.

steps.label:
Gradient formula: G = Δθ / Δt (rise over run from two well-separated points on the best-fit line)
Data range: θ from 25.3°C (t=0) to 56.8°C (t=360s) — use points near the ends of the line for the most accurate gradient
Calculate the gradient G of the θ vs t graph using two well-separated points. (5 marks)

fields.label: Δθ (change in temperature between your chosen points) = _____ °C

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Choose two points far apart on the best-fit line. Δθ = upper temperature − lower temperature from your chosen pair.

fields.label: Δt (change in time between your chosen points) = _____ s
fields.diagnostic_hint: Δt = t₂ − t₁ = 360 − 0 = 360 s (using extreme points)

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Δt = the difference in time values for your two chosen points on the best-fit line.

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: G = Δθ ÷ Δt = 31.5 ÷ 360 = 0.0875 °C/s. Divide the change in temperature by the change in time.
